There is deliberately no baseUrl. Since TypeScript 5.0 a paths entry is
resolved relative to this file, so the '@/*' mapping below needs no anchor,
and setting one is not free: baseUrl makes every bare import resolvable
against that directory, so 'src/types' or 'login/staff-login' would quietly
resolve to a local folder instead of failing like the package import it
looks like. Vite does not read this mapping at all -- it has its own alias
in vite.config.ts -- so the two have to be kept in step by hand.
On the include list: vite.config.ts and tailwind.config.ts are configuration
rather than application code, but they are still TypeScript. Leaving them out
gives the editor 'File is not listed within the file list of project', and
their own type errors would never reach the build.
